account:
Today there has been an unusually well-organised gathering being prepared at the town hall, while my ordinary appointments have remained quiet. No council letters or other new business reached the secretary, who checked the office chest and recorded our appointments. Meanwhile, the builder invited me to the hall at eighteen and deliberately asked to keep the occasion's details until then. The innkeeper described it, through the secretary's report, as community hospitality, with a programme announced at eighteen and no prepared remarks needed. He has now arrived to escort me and asked me to follow him into the hall.

The preparations seem substantial. Yesterday I personally saw both the builder and innkeeper put bread in a hall table chest. The secretary reported lanterns placed in the hall. Today my neighbour told me that all two hundred fresh loaves had been verified there this morning, that guests need bring nothing, and that she had been spreading the innkeeper's invitation. The baker told me she had bought eight hay bales this morning; that might be connected with the bread supply, but I have not verified the entire supply chain or received a full grain-stock report from the miller.

The builder, innkeeper, and neighbour are clearly involved, with the baker apparently contributing to provisioning. My secretary has helped establish what is known but did not know the occasion's explanation. I have also heard fragments of talk about a bridge or port change at the bakery, but I have no verified transport change and cannot make much of those fragments.

I think this is a planned communal feast or celebration, with its exact purpose intentionally kept as a surprise for me. The escort and request to withhold details suggest a special reveal, possibly something in my honour, but that is only a guess. I have decided to respect the surprise and attend; I still do not know what the programme or occasion actually is.
